source: 上外版选择性必修第二册 Unit 1 Scientists 词表(Reading A 钟扬/Reading B 罗莎琳·富兰克林 真词)；IPA 标准词典英音回填；例句原创、科学家主题、含目标词、不超纲优先；多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Zhong Yang was a scientist who gave his life to studying plants.
words.example_cn: 钟扬是一位献身于植物研究的科学家。

words.example_en: Franklin spent her life on scientific research.
words.example_cn: 富兰克林一生都投身于科学研究。

words.example_en: Her work led to a major advance in our understanding of DNA.
words.example_cn: 她的工作使我们对DNA的理解取得了重大进展。

words.example_en: She had an undying passion for science all her life.
words.example_cn: 她一生都对科学怀有不灭的酷爱。

words.example_en: By the age of 26, Franklin had published five papers.
words.example_cn: 到26岁时，富兰克林已经发表了五篇论文。

words.example_en: In Paris she mastered a special X-ray technique.
words.example_cn: 在巴黎她精通了一种特殊的X射线技术。

words.example_en: Franklin was assigned to study the structure of DNA.
words.example_cn: 富兰克林被分派去研究DNA的结构。

words.example_en: For a long time her important work went unnoticed.
words.example_cn: 在很长一段时间里，她重要的工作都未受到注意。

words.example_en: As the only female scientist on the project, she worked alone.
words.example_cn: 作为项目里唯一的女性科学家，她独自工作。

words.example_en: She was careful and wanted more evidence before speaking.
words.example_cn: 她很谨慎，发言前想要更多的证据。

words.example_en: Two other scientists got hold of her data without asking.
words.example_cn: 另外两位科学家未经允许就拿到了她的数据。

words.example_en: Later Franklin began her famous work on viruses.
words.example_cn: 后来富兰克林开始了她著名的病毒研究。

words.example_en: Franklin received little credit for her key discovery.
words.example_cn: 富兰克林为她关键的发现几乎没有得到认可。

words.example_en: She had provided the crucial information about DNA.
words.example_cn: 她提供了关于DNA的至关重要的信息。

words.example_en: Her photograph allowed them to make a breakthrough.
words.example_cn: 她的照片让他们取得了突破。

words.example_en: She was not always respected by her fellow scientists.
words.example_cn: 她并不总是受到同行科学家的尊重。

words.example_en: One of her biggest problems was gender inequality.
words.example_cn: 她最大的问题之一就是性别不平等。

words.example_en: She faced inequality but never lost heart.
words.example_cn: 她面对不平等，却从未灰心。

words.example_en: Women in science often received unfair treatment then.
words.example_cn: 当时科学界的女性常常受到不公平对待。

words.example_en: In 1945 she earned her doctorate in chemistry.
words.example_cn: 1945年她获得了化学博士学位。

words.example_en: We owe this rich seed bank to Zhong Yang.
words.example_cn: 我们把这座丰富的种子库归功于钟扬。

words.example_en: Zhong Yang was a professor of biology.
words.example_cn: 钟扬是一位生物学教授。

words.example_en: Most of the seeds came from the high plateau.
words.example_cn: 大部分种子来自这片高原。

words.example_en: Seed banks help protect the variety of plant life.
words.example_cn: 种子库有助于保护植物生命的多样性。

words.example_en: The plateau is a large elevated plain.
words.example_cn: 这片高原是一大片高出地面的平原。

words.example_en: Collecting seeds at that height was very challenging.
words.example_cn: 在那样的高度采集种子非常有挑战性。

words.example_en: The bank can preserve seeds for over a hundred years.
words.example_cn: 种子库能把种子保存一百多年。

words.example_en: He believed his work would benefit many people.
words.example_cn: 他相信他的工作将造福许多人。

words.example_en: Zhong was deeply devoted to his work in Tibet.
words.example_cn: 钟扬深深专注于他在西藏的工作。

words.example_en: Despite all the hardships, the team persisted.
words.example_cn: 尽管历经种种艰难，团队仍坚持了下来。

words.example_en: Great scientists often show courage in the face of hardship.
words.example_cn: 伟大的科学家常在艰难面前展现勇气。

words.example_en: Zhong made a major contribution as a scientist.
words.example_cn: 钟扬作为科学家做出了重大贡献。

words.example_en: One rare species of peach was very hard to collect.
words.example_cn: 一种稀有的桃子物种极难采集。

words.example_en: Zhong said he had never regretted being a scientist.
words.example_cn: 钟扬说他从不后悔成为一名科学家。

words.meaning_cn: 令人钦佩的；给人深刻印象的
words.example_en: Many readers find Zhong Yang's story impressive.
words.example_cn: 许多读者觉得钟扬的故事令人钦佩。

words.example_en: Some plants only grow at high altitude.
words.example_cn: 有些植物只生长在高海拔地区。

words.example_en: The seeds may have medical or agricultural value.
words.example_cn: 这些种子可能具有医学或农业价值。

words.example_en: Stored seeds may bring medical value in the future.
words.example_cn: 储存的种子未来可能带来医学价值。

words.example_en: Hawking was found to have a serious disease at 21.
words.example_cn: 霍金在21岁时被查出患有一种严重的疾病。

words.example_en: He was diagnosed with a disease called ALS.
words.example_cn: 他被诊断患有一种叫ALS的疾病。

words.example_en: The illness eventually put Hawking in a wheelchair.
words.example_cn: 这种疾病最终使霍金坐上了轮椅。

words.example_en: He feared he would never reach his full potential.
words.example_cn: 他担心自己永远无法发挥全部潜力。

words.example_en: His scientific achievement amazed the whole world.
words.example_cn: 他的科学成就令全世界惊叹。

words.example_en: Today computers help to guide satellites in space.
words.example_cn: 如今计算机帮助引导太空中的卫星。

words.example_en: Modern computers can process information in seconds.
words.example_cn: 现代计算机能在几秒内处理信息。

words.example_en: Decades ago, landing on the moon seemed impossible.
words.example_cn: 几十年前，登月似乎是不可能的。

words.example_en: Hawking turned his suffering into great achievements.
words.example_cn: 霍金把他的苦难化为了伟大的成就。

words.example_en: Curiosity is one of the most important qualities of a scientist.
words.example_cn: 好奇心是科学家最重要的品质之一。
